checks.question: Is every dossier file safe to read, with no hidden or off-page text?
Are all required CTD modules (1 to 5) present?
Is the registration fee receipt attached and valid?
Is a finished-product stability report included (Module 3.2.P.8)?

checks.rule: regulator in trusted_regulators and approval_age_months <= max_age_months
checks.question: Is the reference approval in date and from a trusted regulator?
Is the reference approval free of any foreign suspension or withdrawal?

checks.rule: here.shelf_life_months == there.shelf_life_months and here.strength == there.strength and here.manufacturing_site == there.manufacturing_site
checks.question: Is the product the same as the one in the reference approval (shelf life, strength, site)?
Is long-term stability data given at 30 C / 65% RH for 12 months?
Does the container closure for an oral liquid meet child-resistant packaging requirements?
Is the leaflet dose consistent with the approved text in every language?
Is the marketing authorisation holder a licensed pharmaceutical establishment under the medicines law in force?
Is a pharmacovigilance system summary given, with a named qualified person?
